Overview

Information and Data are some of the most important organizational assets in today’s businesses. As a Security Consultant, you will be a key advisor for IBM’s clients, analysing business requirements to design and implement the best security solutions for their needs. You will apply your technical skills to find the balance between enabling and securing the client’s organization with the cognitive solutions that are making IBM the fastest growing enterprise security business in the world.

Your role and responsibilities

As a Senior Incident Response Consultant for the IBM Security X-Force Incident Response (X-Force IR) team in Latin America, you will be responsible for the growth and delivery of X-Force IR services. You will lead a team of consultants who are responding to high profile cybersecurity incidents within our clients’ enterprise networks. You will work with our clients to proactively prevent and detect future cybersecurity incidents. You will serve as a trusted advisor to our clients, helping to shape their cybersecurity program. You will collaborate with internal IBM stakeholders to provide integrated solutions to our clients’ most challenging problems.

  • Lead a team of consultants responding to high-profile cybersecurity incidents within clients’ enterprise networks.
  • Direct the growth and delivery of X-Force IR services in Latin America.
  • Work with clients to proactively prevent and detect cybersecurity incidents; help shape and mature their cybersecurity programs.
  • Collaborate with internal IBM stakeholders to deliver integrated security solutions.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to clients on incident response, threat intelligence, and security program maturity.

In this role you will have demonstrated skills in various elements of Incident Response, conducting computer intrusion investigations, and have a strong foundation in cyber security policy, operations and best practices; ideally in large enterprise environments. You will have proficiency with leading EDR tools as well as familiarity with forensic analysis tools such as X-Ways, EnCase Forensic or FTK and live response analysis. Furthermore, familiarity with Windows and Linux enterprise environments and systems such as Active Directory, Office 365, FWs, IPS/IDS, SIEMs, etc. is required. Excellent written and verbal communication skills are required. When not responding to breaches, you will conduct enterprise threat hunting, help clients develop incident response plans, facilitate tabletop and purple team exercises as well as provide other strategic security services related to incident response.

Required education

Bachelor's Degree

Required technical and professional expertise

Significant hands-on experience with hardware/software tools used in incident response, computer forensics, network security assessments, and/or application security.

  • Years Experience with assessing and developing enterprise-wide policies and procedures for IT risk mitigation and incident response.
  • Experience leading incident response teams and managing tasks across all phases of an engagement.
  • Experience managing a team of consultants with skills similar to those described below.
  • Capable of working independently as well as providing leadership on internal projects and client engagements.
Forensic Analysis & Incident Response Skills
  • Ability to forensically analyze both Windows & Unix systems for evidence of compromise.
  • Proficiency with industry standard forensic tools such as EnCase, FTK, X-Ways, Sleuthkit.
  • Experience performing log analysis locally and via SIEM/log aggregation tool.
  • Experience hunting threat actors in large enterprise networks and cloud environments.
  • Experience with using and configuring Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR) tools.
  • Demonstrate an understanding of the behaviour, security risks and controls of common network protocols.
  • Demonstrate an understanding of common applications used in Windows and Linux enterprise environment. Familiarity with Active Directory, Exchange and Office365 applications and logs.
  • Familiarity with the tools and techniques required to analyse & reverse diverse protocols and data traversing a network environment.
  • Familiarity with cloud computing platforms like IBM Cloud, AWS, GCP or Azure
  • Proficient in writing cohesive reports for a technical and non-technical audience.
Strategic Assessment Expertise
  • Examine and analyze available client internal policies, processes, and procedures to determine patterns and gaps at both a strategic and tactical levels. Recommend appropriate course of action to support maturing the client’s incident response program and cyber security posture.
  • A strong familiarity with various security frameworks and standards such as ISO 27001/2, PCI DSS, NIST800-53, 800-171, and applicable data privacy laws and regulations.
  • Demonstrated experience with planning, scoping, and delivering technical and/or executive level tabletop exercises, with a focus on either tactical or strategic incident response processes.
  • Ability to incorporate current trends and develop custom scenarios applicable to a client.

• Low-level operating system knowledge, including automation and performing administrative tasks.

• Scripting or programming experience, preferably in a language commonly used for DFIR such as Python or PowerShell.

• Ability to work with data at scale such as using Splunk / ELK.

• Expertise working with shell programs such as grep, sed and awk to process data quickly.

• Working experience with virtualisation and cloud technology platforms like IBM Cloud, AWS, GCP & Azure.

• Communication skills: able to communicate fluently in English or/and Spanish.

Preferred technical and professional experience
  • Diverse understanding of cyber security related vulnerabilities, common attack vectors, and mitigations.
  • Capable of developing strategic level incident response plans as well as tactical-focused playbooks.
  • Ability to manage tasks and coordinate work streams during incident response investigations.
  • Communication skills: able to communicate fluently in English or/and Spanish.

IBM Consulting is IBM’s consulting and global professional services business, with market leading capabilities in business and technology transformation. With deep expertise in many industries, we offer strategy, experience, technology, and operations services to many of the most innovative and valuable companies in the world. Our people are focused on accelerating our clients’ businesses through the power of collaboration. We believe in the power of technology responsibly used to help people, partners and the planet.

Overview

O Instrutor de Well Control é responsável por ministrar treinamentos de Controle de Poço de acordo com os padrões do IADC Well Sharp (níveis Introdutório, Driller e Supervisor – Superfície e Subsea). Este profissional deve assegurar que os participantes adquiram conhecimentos teóricos e práticos para operar com segurança em cenários de perfuração e controle de poços.

The Well Control Instructor is responsible for delivering Well Control training in accordance with IADC WellSharp standards (Introductory, Driller, and Supervisor levels – Surface and Subsea). This professional must ensure that participants acquire the theoretical knowledge and practical skills required to operate safely in drilling and well control scenarios.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Ministrar aulas teóricas e práticas de Controle de Poço conforme o currículo oficial do IADC WellSharp.

  • Aplicar avaliações e exames, garantindo conformidade com os requisitos de qualidade e integridade definidos pelo IADC.

  • Elaborar relatórios de desempenho, registro de frequência e resultados dos alunos no sistema da IADC e nos controles internos.

  • Assegurar a atualização contínua dos materiais didáticos, simuladores e recursos de treinamento, em alinhamento com a versão vigente do programa.

  • Participar de auditorias internas e externas, contribuindo para a manutenção da acreditação do centro de treinamento.

  • Colaborar com a equipe de instrutores e suporte técnico no desenvolvimento e aprimoramento dos cursos.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Certificação: Instrutor aprovado pelo IADC WellSharp para ministrar cursos de Controle de Poço

  • Conhecimento Técnico: - Métodos de controle de poço (Driller’s Method, Wait & Weight, Volumetric, Bullheading) - Pressões de formação, influxo, hidráulica de poço, operações de cimentação e revestimento - Normas e boas práticas internacionais (IADC, IWCF, API, ANP).

  • Idiomas: Inglês avançado (mandatório).

We are looking for

  • Certification: IADC WellSharp-approved Instructor authorized to deliver Well Control courses.

  • Technical Knowledge: - Well control methods (Driller’s Method, Wait & Weight, Volumetric, Bullheading) -Formation pressures, influx behavior, well hydraulics, casing, and cementing operations -International standards and best practices (IADC, IWCF, API, ANP).

  • Languages: Advanced English (mandatory).

A Movida é uma empresa de soluções inovadoras em mobilidade urbana e modelo de negócios com forte direcionamento para desenvolvimento socioambiental. A companhia é reconhecida como uma locadora moderna, alinhada às últimas tendências tecnológicas e que investe em diversificação e renovação de frota, treinamento de funcionários e serviços exclusivos.

A Movida (MOVI3) é uma empresa de aluguel de carros que oferece soluções inovadoras em mobilidade urbana para todo tipo de necessidade. Pioneira em oferecer serviços como aluguel mensal para pessoa física, Wi-Fi no carro, pré-pagamento e ChatBot nas redes sociais, foi a primeira locadora do país a ir além do carro, ajudando a revolucionar o setor de locação no Brasil. Com perfil inovador aliado a forte governança corporativa, atua tanto no varejo, com aluguel de carros, como no mercado corporativo, com a terceirização de frotas para empresas, além da venda de seminovos. Somos uma empresa que valoriza as pessoas e tudo o que elas representam: a energia das ideias, da contribuição, da parceria e da colaboração. Por isso, nos dedicamos a construir um ambiente de trabalho propício ao desenvolvimento humano e profissional dos nossos colaboradores, sempre incentivando a interação, a participação ativa e o crescimento. Gostamos de quem acrescenta, porque acreditamos que o sucesso vem da soma da energia com a colaboração.

Somos uma empresa do Grupo SHV Energy, líder mundial na distribuição de GLP e uma das principais distribuidoras de gás LP no Brasil, com mais de 75 anos de atuação. Possuímos o mais moderno parque engarrafador da América Latina e contamos com mais de 20 unidades industriais distribuídas pelo país, de norte a sul. Senior Product Manager (Bangkok-based) – Agoda

Join to apply for the Senior Product Manager (Bangkok-based) role at Agoda .

About Agoda

Agoda is an online travel booking platform for accommodations, flights, and more. We build and deploy cutting-edge technology that connects travelers with a global network of 4.7M hotels and holiday properties worldwide, plus flights, activities, and more. Based in Asia and part of Booking Holdings, our 7,100+ employees representing 95+ nationalities in 27 markets foster a work environment rich in diversity, creativity, and collaboration. We innovate through a culture of experimentation and ownership, enhancing the ability for our customers to experience the world.

Our Purpose - Bridging the World Through Travel

We believe travel allows people to enjoy, learn and experience more of the amazing world we live in. It brings individuals and cultures closer together, fostering empathy, understanding and happiness. We are a skillful, driven and diverse team from across the globe, united by a passion to make an impact. Harnessing our innovative technologies and strong partnerships, we aim to make travel easy and rewarding for everyone.

Your opportunity

This role is BANGKOK-BASED, RELOCATION PROVIDED. Our Senior Product Managers are analytical and data-driven individuals, responsible for building products end-to-end, focusing on analyzing and experimenting until our solutions are perfectly tailored to our travelers. You will drive product strategy and partner closely with senior leadership cross-functionally to define, build, and deliver the best travel solutions. You will get dedicated engineering resources that you, and only you, define and allocate. We expect you to have a hands-on mentality and spend considerable time with your SCRUM teams, have enthusiasm to develop engineered processes and technologies and apply innovative solutions to make organizational improvements. Product Managers can modify every system we have in our company to suit their needs.

By applying to this role, you'll be considered for a role either in User Experience, Marketing, Finance or Supply product vertical. The goal is to match you with the team that best aligns with your interests, competencies, and where you will have the most impact. We’re looking for Senior Product Managers for every part of our business. Our entire Product team sits in Bangkok. This is an Individual Contributor position.

You will get to:

  • Analyze the online travel ecosystem, markets, competitive landscape and user requirements
  • Conceptualize, launch and optimize products and features, experiment, test their performance and iterate quickly
  • Work collaboratively with Engineering, Marketing, Legal and UX teams on cutting-edge technologies
  • Develop innovative solutions to some of the world’s difficult problems by collaborating as needed across regions, product areas, and functions

What you'll need to succeed:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field (e.g., Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Mathematics, or similar quantitative discipline)

  • Experience developing and launching products

  • Entrepreneurial and analytical skills; effective at breaking down complex problems and driving and managing change
  • Hands-on mentality

Nice to have:

  • MBA or Master’s degree in Math, Economics, Computer Science or Statistics
  • Data tools - SQL, Python, R, or equivalent

title: Senior maintenance engineer rotating equipment
description:
Overview

As a Senior Maintenance Engineer, you will collaborate closely with the clients Maintenance Engineering, Planning, and Offshore Operations teams, as well as Shapes remote specialists, to implement and optimize data-driven maintenance strategies for critical rotating equipment in the Oil & Gas sector. Your role will focus on condition monitoring, technical data analysis, and providing actionable recommendations to enhance equipment reliability, availability, and operational performance.

We are looking for a technically skilled professional with strong experience in predictive maintenance and rotating machinery diagnostics, capable of working across multidisciplinary teams to support continuous improvement.

Responsibilities
  • Analyze inspection and test data, focusing on vibration analysis (including spectra) and lubricant analysis to detect early signs of equipment failure.
  • Diagnose equipment condition and recommend corrective and predictive maintenance actions.
  • Create work notifications and service orders (WO/Notification) in CMMS to ensure accurate execution of maintenance activities.
  • Evaluate intervention effectiveness by analyzing results and calculating avoided costs.
  • Develop technical reports and performance indicators related to equipment and maintenance strategy.
  • Maintain and update technical case studies in Shape Lighthouse, ensuring traceability and knowledge retention.
  • Collaborate integrally with offshore teams, client engineering and planning, and Shapes remote specialists.
  • Support continuous development and enhancement of predictive maintenance strategies.
  • Ensure operational integrity, safety, and compliance with industry standards.
Requirements
  • Bachelors degree in Mechanical, Mechatronics, or related fields.
  • Proven experience in predictive maintenance, reliability, and diagnostics of rotating equipment (compressors, pumps, turbomachinery, etc.).
  • Advanced skills in vibration analysis, spectra interpretation, and condition monitoring data.
  • Knowledge of lubricant analysis and interpretation of physicochemical and particulate parameters.
  • Familiarity with maintenance management systems such as SAP PM, Maximo, or equivalents.
  • Experience with asset monitoring systems like OSIsoft PI, SCADA, or similar.
  • Understanding of predictive, prescriptive, and condition-based maintenance strategies.
  • Desirable certifications in vibration analysis (ISO CAT II or higher) and lubricant analysis.
Differentials
  • Previous experience in offshore environments (FPSOs, platforms, refineries, etc.).
  • Knowledge of industry standards such as API, ISO, NR-13.
  • Experience with failure analysis methodologies (FMEA, RCA, RCM).
  • Intermediate to advanced technical English.
Benefits
  • PPR (Profit Sharing): Possibility of extra compensation based on the companys results, according to your performance.
  • Health and Dental Plan: To ensure your care and well-being!
  • Flexible Benefit: Receive an amount that can be used according to your needs, including food, transportation, education, culture, and health. You decide how to use it!
  • Flexible Hours: Work at the best time for you and have a better quality of life.
  • Massages and Manicure in the Office: So you can relax and feel good about yourself.
  • Mentorship Program: Access development opportunities with the help of experienced professionals.
  • Gympass: To keep your health in check and take care of your body.
  • Snacks in the Office: Because everyone loves a snack at work!
  • Inclusive Environment: We value diversity and always strive to create a space where everyone can be authentic, respected, and feel part of something bigger.
  • Day off in Your Birthday Month: A day off in your birthday month to celebrate in any way you prefer
  • Extended Maternity/Paternity Leave: So you can enjoy this important time with your family, with peace of mind that your professional life will remain well-supported.
  • Childcare Assistance: To support you with the care of your young children.
  • Continuous Individualized Development Support: We offer support for your professional growth, respecting your personal needs and goals.
  • Culture and Well-being: We create an environment that values mental health, work-life balance, and encourages connection with culture.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

The National Associate & Regional Director (NARD) will support the daily operations of Howard University and the PNC National Center for Entrepreneurship (“the Center”). The NARD will play a critical leadership role in advancing the mission of the Center by supporting program strategy, partnership development, and national coordination of entrepreneurship initiatives. The NARD will collaborate with campus partners, funders, faculty, and student leaders to promote business innovation, entrepreneurship education, and venture creation.

This individual, who will report directly to the National Executive Director (NED), will serve as a critical broker between program funders, colleagues, students, the University, and the broader community. In this position, the NARD will assist the NED in managing the strategic and operations of the National Center including, working closely with Regional Directors in the center network, developing curriculum and programmatic activities, creating lecture opportunities for executives, managing and establishing relationships across the University and within varying sectors, creating program timelines, marketing of program outcomes, and any other related duties to help the success of the Center.

In addition, the NARD will assist the NED in tracking quantifiable data and statistical evidence to qualify the success of the Center. This will include tracking student and entrepreneur success and recommend ways in which improvements could be to assure the success of the Center. The NARD will also assist the NED in formally planning, assigning, directing, and coordinating the work of the Center employees.

Supervisory Accountability

title: Senior Research Analyst
description:
Role Purpose

Establishing resilient, sustainable and reliable portfolios is critical to energy companies as they develop agile business models to navigate the Energy Transition. We strive to be the partner of choice in offering a range of world-class products and services to support the business needs of these companies. Our global Subsurface Research Team delivers integrated research, data analysis and industry-leading thought leadership, across the geo-energy landscape, enabling customers to make quicker, more effective decisions. The scope, integrity and connectivity of our Subsurface dataset are foundational to our goal of delivering the market’s leading Subsurface solution. Additionally, the integration of high quality technical and commercial data is critical to enabling our customers to execute high value workflows and deliver data-driven insights to inform investment decisions for the Energy Transition. Reporting into our Subsurface Research Leadership, an experienced, highly motivated, innovative and performance oriented Senior Analyst is required to ensure analytics readiness, across our Subsurface dataset, for the Americas region.

Main Responsibilities
  • Work with the Upstream data function, Subsurface research analysts and the regional Upstream research teams, to ensure delivery of the Subsurface data expansion plan, including meeting agreed data coverage, completeness, integrity and timing OKRs – warranting that all options to deliver the plan have been explored / utilised
  • Work with Subsurface research analysts, and the Upstream product function, to ensure seamless connectivity (e.g. across basins, plays, prospects, wells and field reservoirs) of our Subsurface dataset
  • Ensure the that our Subsurface dataset is analytics ready for customers. Collaborate with our Upstream regional research teams to affect a cultural shift in Subsurface data accountability
  • Support the delivery of our Subsurface Value Creation Plan roadmap through deep participation in, and collaboration across, the associated workstreams
  • Build and develop a strong relationship network with our customers. Engage to understand their use cases, workflows, pain points and data needs in support of the continuous improvement of our offer
  • Help to build organisational capability within the data function through teaching, coaching and advising less experienced staff in support of Subsurface data excellence
  • Support the Subsurface team’s vision and agenda and be a positive advocate for Wood Mackenzie’s brand
  • Embrace, practise and demonstrate Wood Mackenzie’s core values on teamwork and collaboration, respect, integrity, fairness and valuing diversity
About You

You are passionate about the energy sector and the role it plays in delivering energy to the world. You have a curious and analytical mindset, understand the power of Subsurface data, and excited by the potential of AI across the Upstream value chain.

You are passionate about performance excellence and able to analyse and form clear, coherent conclusions from a variety of data and information. You find it easy communicating complex or technical information and delivering messages that are easily understood.

You thrive in a collaborative, commercial and client-centric environment and proven track record of fostering strong working relationships through coaching, influencing and developing others around you. The people around you recognise your ability to develop others and build an environment in which people thrive and deliver high quality results.

The way in which you work is productive and driven, striving to be best in class. You share ideas and take accountability. The way in which you work enables you to build strong, collaborative internal relationships and influence stakeholders at all levels of the wider organization. You understand that diversity of experience and thought is important and that working across different geographies requires cultural appreciation.

If you are looking for a role where you can be part of a dynamic team, that is supporting clients to make better informed decisions, and influence how we power our planet, apply now.

Qualifications And Capabilities
  • Minimum of a BSc in a Geoscience discipline; a data science qualification would be an advantage.
  • 5-10 years of Subsurface experience within the Upstream sector with a strong understanding of the petroleum geology of the Americas and deep exposure to common Subsurface use cases, workflows and data usage.
  • Demonstrable data analytical skills and experience of working with databases.
  • Up-to-date knowledge of the utilisation of AI across the Upstream Subsurface space.
  • Experience in external relationship building and management.
  • Strong commercial acumen.
  • Demonstrable curiosity with a track record of impactful innovation.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • A track record in demonstrating differentiated values and behaviours with a particular focus on teamwork and collaboration.
Expectations
  • We are a hybrid working company and the successful applicant will be required to be physically present in the office at least 2 days per week to foster and contribute to a collaborative environment. Full-time remote working is not an option for this role.
  • Due to the global nature of the team, a degree of flexible working will be required to accommodate different time zones.
Wood Mackenzie Values

description:

Join to apply for the Global Head of Cloud Alliances role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Head of Cloud Alliances to lead business development and partnerships with the global public clouds. As the publisher of Ubuntu, Canonical is already a trusted partner with the leading guest OS and select services for the major hyperscalers. We have a large portfolio of open source software on the cloud marketplace for enterprise customers, and are looking to expand our global cloud partnerships.

Reporting to the VP of Global Alliances, the Global Head of Cloud Alliances will lead teams that bring innovation to the public cloud platforms, joint go-to-market with public cloud sales communities and marketplaces, and our global customer and partner contracts. They will work closely with cloud partners, from engineering to product management and marketing, to deliver open source solutions at scale for their cloud customers.

Our Cloud Alliance team builds trusted relationships with partners at all levels, from joint technical work to executive strategy. Their goal is to increase Canonical market share in the cloud ISV ecosystem, develop cloud channel sales, evangelize the partnership and lead all business interactions. The Global Head of Cloud Alliances will own the strategy, sell-to, sell-through and sell-with motions with all cloud partners, as well as promotion of our cloud related activities - from campaigns, to strategic opportunities and cloud related events.

Our company is largely distributed, this role can be based anywhere in the Americas or EMEA.

The role entails

  • Taking ownership of Canonical's global cloud partner strategy, leading efforts to forecast, driving bookings, and growing revenue worldwide
  • Building strong, cross-functional relationships across teams to ensure a unified approach to technology and market execution
  • Inspiring and guiding teams to achieve accelerated revenue growth with Cloud partners, continually refining and evolving strategies for success
  • Establishing and nurturing executive-level relationships with key partners, laying the foundation for long-term success and mutual growth
  • Steering our offering from concept to execution, aligning product management and marketing strategies while scaling success through our global sales organization

What we are looking for in you:

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Leadership and commitment to skills development and mentorship
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Exceptional leadership and presentation skills, capable of energizing teams and stakeholders while delivering compelling data-driven narratives
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite, and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organization
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
  • An in-depth understanding of open source technologies, Ubuntu, and the competitive ecosystem, with an eye for identifying opportunities that others might miss.
  • Autonomous, disciplined, and proactive—take ownership, and deliver exceptional results

Nice to have

  • A track record in alliance and indirect sales management, with an ability to build partnerships that drive success
  • Solid experience in the Public Cloud sector, coupled with an understanding of the evolving landscape of technology and innovation.
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.
